input_description: Build a mobile-first personal consumer loan app for applicants seeking unsecured loans. Applicants create accounts, enter identity, address, income, and requested loan amount and term. The app performs a soft credit inquiry for prequalification, collects a government-issued ID, and connects to the applicant's bank account for income verification. It applies configurable eligibility and underwriting rules; straightforward cases may be approved automatically, while borderline cases go to a human underwriter. Applicants can review disclosures, select a payment date, and e-sign the agreement. Approved funds are sent to the linked bank account by ACH. Borrowers can view their repayment schedule and make payments or configure autopay. Internal underwriters review flagged applications; administrators manage decision rules and rates. For this test scenario, assume auditability and security are critical, requirements change frequently, continuous delivery is desired, there are no legacy-system constraints, complexity is high, testing/documentation needs are high, and schedule/budget pressure is moderate.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow consumers to apply for unsecured personal loans through a mobile-first application.
The system shall provide role-appropriate access for applicants, underwriters, and system administrators.
The system shall support the application flow from account creation and loan request through prequalification, underwriting, offer acceptance, disbursement, and repayment servicing.
The system shall evaluate loan applications against configurable eligibility and underwriting rules.
The system shall collect applicant identity, address, income, requested loan amount, requested term, and a government-issued identification document.
The system shall request a soft credit inquiry for applicant prequalification.
The system shall automatically approve applications that satisfy configured rules and route borderline applications to a human underwriter.
The system shall connect to an applicant's bank account to verify income.
The system shall allow an approved applicant to electronically sign the loan agreement.
The system shall disburse approved loan funds by ACH to the applicant's linked bank account.
The system shall show borrowers their repayment schedule and allow them to make payments or configure autopay.
The project expects requirements to change frequently.
The project treats auditability as critical and requires strong security.
